top_stories.title: Cisco Zero-Day Highlights API Endpoint Authentication Issues
top_stories.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-76460) affecting Cisco's Identity Services Engine (ISE) has been disclosed, receiving a maximum CVSS score of 10.0. The zero-day flaw targets API endpoint authentication in Cisco ISE, a widely deployed network access control and identity management platform.

top_stories.title: Okta adds AI agent runtime gateway, forms Blueprint Alliance with AWS and CrowdStrike
top_stories.summary: Okta announced a runtime enforcement gateway and expanded kill switch capabilities for its Okta for AI Agents platform at its Oktane conference. The company also formed the Blueprint Alliance alongside AWS, CrowdStrike, and 11 other vendors as part of the announcement.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Disrupts EvilTokens Device Code Phishing Service
top_stories.summary: Microsoft seized 50 websites and disabled over 150 domains to disrupt EvilTokens, a phishing-as-a-service platform targeting Microsoft 365 accounts. The operation targeted device code phishing attacks designed to steal authentication tokens and bypass MFA protections.

top_stories.title: Rogue external MFA providers can steal passwords during logins
top_stories.summary: Security researchers developed an attack technique that allows hackers with privileged access to register a rogue external MFA provider capable of stealing user passwords during legitimate login attempts. The attack exploits the trust relationship between identity systems and external MFA providers, targeting the authentication flow itself.

top_stories.title: F5 Patches Critical BIG-IP APM Zero-Day Exploited for Unauthenticated RCE on OAuth Servers
top_stories.summary: F5 has patched a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-94127) in BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution. The flaw specifically affects BIG-IP systems where APM is configured as an OAuth authorization server, and F5 has released engineering hotfixes following disclosure on September 22.

news.title: F5 patches BIG-IP APM zero-day flaw exploited in RCE attacks
news.summary: F5 has released security updates to patch a critical zero-day vulnerability in BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM) that was being actively exploited in remote code execution attacks. BIG-IP APM is an access management and authentication proxy solution, making this flaw directly relevant to IAM infrastructure deployments.

news.title: Portnox detects and removes unauthorized AI applications from managed devices
news.summary: Portnox has launched new capabilities to detect and automatically remove unauthorized AI applications from managed devices, addressing "shadow AI" risks. The feature enforces security policy by restricting, quarantining, or removing unapproved AI agents that access enterprise data using the permissions of the logged-in user.

news.title: Microsoft Takes Down EvilTokens Device-Code Phishing Service Tied to 12,000 Inbox Compromises
news.summary: Microsoft has taken down the EvilTokens device-code phishing service, which was linked to approximately 12,000 inbox compromises and used AI throughout its attack chain. The takedown was authorized by a U.S. federal court and carried out in collaboration with Health-ISAC, Cloudflare, Coinbase, OpenAI, and other partners.

news.title: AI Agents Are Rewriting the Rules of Lateral Movement
news.summary: The article examines how AI agents create new challenges for access management by autonomously discovering and exploiting access paths beyond what traditional identity governance models anticipate. Unlike humans or deterministic applications, AI agents can relentlessly explore lateral movement opportunities using existing permissions, complicating least-privilege and authorization enforcement strategies.

news.title: EntraTrace
news.summary: EntraTrace is a defensive research tool designed to document observable API endpoints and user agents used by offensive tooling that targets Microsoft Entra ID. The tool is intended to support detection engineering and incident response efforts against attacks on Microsoft's identity platform.

news.title: Lumos Launches MCP Governance to Provide Agent Runtime Security
news.summary: Lumos, an identity management platform, has launched MCP Governance to provide runtime security and visibility over Model Context Protocol (MCP) usage and AI agent tool calls. The initial release supports Claude Code and Codex, targeting security and IT teams seeking control over agentic AI interactions.

news.title: Unmasking EvilTokens: Getting to the root of device code phishing
news.summary: Microsoft's Digital Crimes Unit disrupted EvilTokens, a Phishing-as-a-Service (PhaaS) platform enabling device code phishing attacks that steal authentication tokens. The platform used AI-assisted lures and automated infrastructure to bypass MFA by hijacking OAuth device code flows, directly targeting identity and authentication mechanisms.

news.title: What to expect during Okta’s Oktane event: Join theCUBE Sept. 24
news.summary: Okta's Oktane event is scheduled for September 24, with theCUBE providing coverage of the conference. The event is expected to focus on identity security for AI agents, including how enterprises should govern AI agent identities as they access systems and execute tasks across workflows.

news.title: Dear Okta Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for September 22
news.summary: Okta has announced its Oktane 2026 conference will open in Las Vegas on September 22. The event is expected to feature Okta's AI agent security platform as a central focus.

news.title: Show HN: Venya lets AI agents use secrets without seeing them
news.summary: A GitHub project called Venya has been published that provides privileged access management for AI agents, preventing the agents from directly accessing secrets while still enabling their use. The implementation uses FIDO2 authentication, remote executor sandboxes, and Model Context Protocol for LLM-driven operations.

news.title: Aembit Launches Support for Okta Cross App Access, Extending Enterprise Identity Controls to AI Agents
news.summary: Aembit has launched support for Okta Cross App Access, extending enterprise identity controls to AI agents. The integration aims to apply existing Okta-based identity and authorization frameworks to non-human identities in agentic AI workflows.

news.title: Jim Cramer Praises OKTA for Tackling AI Security Threats
news.summary: Jim Cramer mentioned Okta on CNBC's Mad Money following conversations with Silicon Valley technology leaders, highlighting the company in relation to AI security threats. The segment was a brief on-air mention ahead of an upcoming Okta analyst event, with no specific product or business developments disclosed.

news.title: Okta Stock Rides AI Security Boom Ahead Of Investor Day
news.summary: Okta's stock has surged over 115% in 2026 ahead of the company's annual customer conference and investor day. The stock gains are driven by investor sentiment around AI-based security threats increasing demand for identity security solutions.

news.title: Siemens Industrial Edge Management
news.summary: Siemens Industrial Edge Management has been found to contain an authentication bypass vulnerability enabling unauthenticated remote attackers to perform full account takeover by resetting user credentials without email verification. Siemens has issued a CSAF advisory addressing the flaw.

news.title: zitadel v4.18.0
news.summary: Zitadel released version 4.18.0 of its open-source identity and access management platform. The platform supports SSO, MFA, passkeys, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and multi-tenant access control for developers and enterprises.

news.title: Okta Wants Identity to Be the Control Plane for AI Agents
news.summary: At Oktane 2026 in Las Vegas, Okta is positioning identity as the central control plane for governing AI agents. The event focuses on the operational mechanics of AI agent governance, reflecting a shift in the industry from AI novelty to practical identity management frameworks for agentic systems.

news.title: Fake LastPass Authenticator Installer Abuses Microsoft-Signed Driver to Kill Antivirus and EDR
news.summary: Researchers at LastPass and Delphos Labs discovered a fake LastPass Authenticator installer on GitHub that deploys a Microsoft-signed Windows kernel driver to disable antivirus and EDR tools before executing a password stealer. The malicious driver, signed through Microsoft's hardware-compatibility program, achieved zero detections on VirusTotal, making it particularly difficult to identify as a threat.

news.title: Needham Just Upped Its Price Target on OKTA Stock. Here's Why.
news.summary: Needham analyst Mike Cikas raised the price target on Okta (OKTA) stock to $230. The upgrade reflects bullish sentiment on the IAM vendor's financial outlook.

news.title: MFA Won't Save You From OAuth Consent Abuse
news.summary: The article addresses a security gap where OAuth consent abuse can bypass MFA protections entirely. The piece argues that organizations require OAuth governance controls including least-privilege scopes, consent monitoring, and rapid token revocation to mitigate this attack vector.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, with evidence pointing to a breach at a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the source of the leaked images.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian hacker Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for breaching over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in data theft and extortion including over 100 million AT&T customer records.
